description: This file defines the public API for PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) drivers in the Zephyr RTOS, including data structures, macros, function prototypes, and inline functions for configuring and controlling PWM hardware, as well as capture features.

methods.name: pwm_set_cycles
methods.description: Sets the PWM period and pulse width in clock cycles for a device channel.

methods.name: pwm_get_cycles_per_sec
methods.description: Retrieves the PWM clock rate in cycles per second for a device channel.

methods.name: pwm_configure_capture
methods.description: Configures PWM capture for a specific channel with callback.

methods.name: pwm_enable_capture
methods.description: Enables PWM capture on a channel.

methods.name: pwm_disable_capture
methods.description: Disables PWM capture on a channel.

methods.name: pwm_capture_cycles
methods.description: Captures PWM period and pulse width in clock cycles, blocking until complete or timeout.

methods.name: pwm_capture_usec
methods.description: Captures PWM period and pulse width in microseconds, blocking until complete or timeout.

methods.name: pwm_capture_nsec
methods.description: Captures PWM period and pulse width in nanoseconds, blocking until complete or timeout.

methods.name: pwm_is_ready_dt
methods.description: Checks if the PWM device specified in devicetree is ready.
